one_liner: CivicState is a useful paid civic-letter workflow, but not investible until demand and deliverability prove out.
honestyLabels: All quantitative market, GTM, valuation, and volume claims are tagged as evidence or assumption in BUSINESS.md and .ultra-start/business-plan.json.

strengths: Clear transactional pricing at $5, $15, and $25 [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
Concrete product scaffold across web, API, worker, and Prisma schema [evidence: apps/web/app/submit/page.tsx; apps/api/src/index.ts; apps/worker/src/index.ts; packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma]
Explicit validation gates for 3% conversion, 85% inbox placement, and official coverage [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
weaknesses: Registry marks the asset Watchlist and personal/research, not near-term investible [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch registry note, 2026-06-20]
Project identity conflicts with dispatch naming [evidence: dispatch; package.json]
Market size and GTM are unvalidated assumptions because this worker had no network access
requiredNextProof: Operator ruling on brooks-history versus CivicState by 2026-07-15 [assumption: schedule]
Paid beta showing at least 3% conversion [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
.gov deliverability test showing at least 85% inbox placement [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]

decision: Keep Watchlist until operator and market validation; do not pitch as a near-term investible BOS yet.
